title: Information value beyond the stopwatch (B1) for the 18 transfer-map links

prereg.status_of_evidence: SECONDARY and NOT BLIND. The beyond-B2 results (E008) and raw correlations for these 18 links are already known, and B1 is nested in B2 (B2 = B1 + draft pick), so these results are partly predictable. Report them as a second column of the transfer map, not as new discoveries.

settings.key_note: linkage.evaluate was called with draft_controls=[] for B1, so in link_results_b1 every key named 'B2' (delta_r2_vs_B2, cv_r2['B2']) refers to the B1 baseline; cv_r2['B1'] and cv_r2['B2'] are identical there.

test_labels.prereg_family_secondary_not_blind: 18 links beyond B1 (linkage.evaluate draft_controls=[], rev 3), one BH family of 18. This is E009's preregistered family (the protocol's 'primary' tier for this experiment), but its prereg labels the evidence SECONDARY and NOT BLIND (E008's beyond-B2 results were known; B1 is nested in B2): not confirmatory, and not to be pooled as confirmatory primaries into a hero claim. It is counted with the round-3 primaries only in the conservative post hoc BH (summary.post_hoc_c4_precision_and_families).
test_labels.prespecified_robustness: seeds 1-2 when fl_p < 0.10; without the 2025 class (all 18); leave-3-out (3 most supportive players beyond B1) for links passing criterion 1; the difference in partial r between B1 and B2 (draft_delta_signed)
test_labels.post_hoc: paired-bootstrap interval and FWL decomposition of the B1-B2 difference; beyond-B1 reliability-corrected intervals, joint Bonferroni ceilings and one-sided MDE (E008's bound definitions); two-sided Freedman-Lane p (descriptive); BH over the 36 B1 + B2 tests for links passing criterion 1; E008's beyond-B2 tests re-judged under rev 3 (b2_*: inference identical to E008, asserted; criteria 2, 3, 6 recomputed); exposure re-checked (identical targets)
test_labels.post_hoc_after_review: Freedman-Lane p at 2,000,000 permutations for links with p < 0.10 (precise_fl) and criterion 4 under other permutation seeds and BH families, incl. the round-3 primaries and all round-3 tests (summary.post_hoc_c4_precision_and_families; b1_c4_status); criterion 3 on robust null scales from an exact replay of the harness LOCO null (robust_loco; summary.post_hoc_robust_loco; *_passes_1to6_robust_loco_*); delete-one jackknife interval of the draft-slot difference (draft_delta_jack_*); beyond-B1 q over E008's family (b1_bh_q_e008_family); null ranges signed to the expected direction; verdict text listing every failed part of criterion 6

test_count.note: seed reruns, two-sided p and precise p re-test hypotheses already counted; the 38 = 18 beyond B1 + 18 without 2025 + 2 leave-3-out enter the round-3 all-tests BH with E010's tests

criteria_definitions.c1_fl_p_and_sign: one-sided Freedman-Lane p < 0.05 and partial r in the expected direction
criteria_definitions.c2_excess_lb_gt_0: checks.excess_lb_gt_0 (rev 3: excess - SE > 0 and sign not reversed)
criteria_definitions.c3_loco_2of3: checks.loco_classes_pass >= 2/3 (rev 3: held-out excess > 1 null SD and class partial r not reversed)
criteria_definitions.c4_bh_q_lt_05: beyond B1: BH over the 18 links (prereg; 10,000 permutations, seed 0); beyond B2: as in E008 (14 round-1 primaries; E001 over 18). Post hoc b1_c4_status: 'marginal' when the pass/fail of q < 0.05 differs across permutation seeds, 2,000,000 permutations (+2 MC SE) or BH family (E008's 14, round-3 primaries, all round-3 tests)
criteria_definitions.c5_reliability_ge_05: as-used feature and target reliability >= 0.5 (E008 values; baseline-independent)
criteria_definitions.c6_seeds_and_leave3out: seeds 0-2 each pass c1-c3 (rev 3; seeds run only when fl_p < 0.10) and the leave-3-out sample passes c1 (beyond B1: run for links passing c1; beyond B2: E008's leave-3-out)

verification.notes: transfer_rows asserts beyond-B2 residual reliabilities, as-used reliabilities, exposure correlations and both partial r against E008.json; draft_absorption reports the FWL identity error; wr_speed_signal beyond B2 asserted against E008

summary.note_null_ranges: expected_direction = sign x partial r (+ = predicted direction); raw = as estimated. The first E009 version reported the raw range under the name 'signed' (as E008's summary.transfer.nulls_signed_partial_r does; there the two ranges coincide).

E006-P1.note: the other round-1 p-values are rev-1 (sign-agnostic dR2 permutation) values

post_hoc_c4_precision_and_families.definitions: q = BH q of this link's test in the named family, with this link's p replaced as stated and every other p as in the prereg run (10k permutations, seed 0)

families.q18: E009 prereg family (18 links beyond B1)
families.q_e008_family: E008's family: the 14 round-1 primaries (E001 links over all 18)
families.q_round3_all_tests: 59 round-3 tests with a p (38 E009 + 21 E010; E011 none)
families.q_all_round1_tests: E008's BH across all ~90 round-1 tests (beyond B2 only)

post_hoc_robust_loco.label: post hoc after review (criterion 3's null scale); the rev-3 harness rule stays binding

rules.harness: excess (gain - null mean) > null SD (rev 3, binding)
rules.median_mad: gain - null median > 1.4826 x null MAD

post_hoc_robust_loco.replay: exact: 44 harness runs x 3 classes, max |replay - stored| 0.0e+00

E002-P1.label: Route-drill speed kept → OUT/IN retention (route style)
caveats: Game OUT/IN 'retention' mostly measures how often the break is a turnaround/sit-down (route style); r = 0.89 with game turn radius, so it is not speed carried through a 90-degree cut.
Combine route drills are run at submaximal speed (drill stem speed uncorrelated with the 40, r = -0.14).
E002-P1.scout_sentence: A receiver who keeps more speed through Combine route-drill breaks keeps more speed through game breaks.

E002-P2.label: Route-drill speed kept → separation at throw over exp.
caveats: Separation at pass_forward mostly precedes the break on timing routes.
Target reliability 0.41 < 0.5 (separation over expected, HITCH/OUT/IN).
Outcome target: also run without the 2025 class.
2025 class has one season of games (rookie year only).
E002-P2.scout_sentence: ...and so separates more at the throw on breaking routes.

E002-P3.label: Stop-route drill braking → HITCH braking
caveats: Combine stop-braking composite is confounded with draft class (2025 COMEBACK is a different movement); reliability 0.44 < 0.5, and 0.17 within draft year.
Low power: n ~ 62 with ~19 B2 columns + year dummies.
E002-P3.scout_sentence: A receiver who brakes harder into Combine curls/comebacks brakes harder on hitches.

E003-P1.label: 40 first-second burst → first-second rush distance
caveats: Game burst window runs into blocker contact and stunts (not pure acceleration).
40-yd burst carries a Combine-year artifact (beyond-B2 reliability 0.62 -> 0.51 with year removed).
Game burst correlates +0.31 with log pass-rush snaps (exposure).
E003-P1.scout_sentence: A lineman who covers more ground in the first second of the 40 bursts harder off the ball.

E003-P2.label: 40 first-second burst → NGS get-off (incl. snap reaction)
caveats: NGS get-off mixes reaction to the snap (not measurable at the Combine) with burst.
E003-P2.scout_sentence: ...and gets off the ball faster (NGS get-off).

E003-P3.label: 40 first-second burst → quick pressures over exp.
caveats: Quick-pressure rate over expected is exposure-tied (r = +0.39 with log snaps in round 1).
Outcome target: also run without the 2025 class.
2025 class has one season of games (rookie year only).

E004-P1.label: Mirror reversal accel. → set accel. 0-0.6 s after snap
caveats: Target (peak acceleration 0-0.6 s after the snap) is scheme/reaction, not the Combine construct; teammate r = 0.29.
Mirror-drill reliability is within one attempt (single attempt per player; the partner/tempo of that rep is confounded).
E004-P1.scout_sentence: A lineman who swings his momentum harder in the mirror drill accelerates harder into his pass set.

E004-P2.label: Mirror reversal accel. → pressure prob. allowed over exp.
caveats: Outcome traits correlate -0.36 with log pass-block snaps (exposure).
Only the mirror metric was tested; the wave-drill metric was screened out on reliability (untested).
B2 cross-validated R^2 is negative: very low power.
2025 class has one season of games (rookie year only).

E004-P3.label: Mirror reversal accel. → pressures allowed over exp.
caveats: Target reliability 0.42 < 0.5; trait correlates -0.35 with log snaps.
Only the mirror metric was tested (the wave drill is untested).
2025 class has one season of games (rookie year only).

E005-P1.label: Drill backpedal speed → pre-throw peak retreat speed
caveats: Game 'peak backpedal speed' is mostly retreat speed at the hip flip, the throw or the 2.5 s cutoff, not backpedal speed.
Game backpedal reliability (0.85) is partly a team/scheme effect (odd/even games cannot separate player from team).
E005-P1.scout_sentence: A DB with a faster drill backpedal backpedals faster in coverage.

E005-P2.label: Drill plant-and-drive dv → post-throw redirection dv
caveats: Target is generic post-throw redirection (often deep safeties pursuing short completions), not 'breaking on the ball'.
E005-P2.scout_sentence: A DB with a sharper drill plant-and-drive transitions faster once the ball is thrown.

E006-P1.sign_source: inferred from the E006 hypothesis text (the prereg has no expected_sign field)
E006-P1.label: Fitted 40 vmax → extrapolated game top-speed capacity S0
caveats: Near re-test of E001 (S0 r ~ 0.85 with E001's target; E001 was seen before the prereg): not independent confirmation. Same 61 WRs as E001-WR; B2-residual feature r 0.77, target r 0.83 (wr_speed_signal).

Rests on few players: the 3 most supportive WRs carry ~42% of the partial r; without them r +0.31 with 95% CI including 0 (one-sided p 0.03 passes criterion 6 as defined). Without the rookie-only 2025 class r +0.38; by class +0.29 / +0.50 / +0.67.
Passes BH over the 14 primaries (q 0.010), not across all ~90 round-1 tests (q ~ 0.06).
The directly observed game top speed (E001-WR, q95 of play max) is weaker: fails BH and leave-3-out.
Expected sign '+' inferred from the hypothesis text (the prereg has no sign field); two-sided p ~ 0.001.
Vanishes once a raw tracked flying split is added to B2: the signal is tracked flying speed, not curve shape.
S0 extrapolates ~1 yd/s beyond observed game speeds; round-1 S0 used R = 20 Monte Carlo draws (shared module now R = 1000; see post hoc).
No performance consequence yet (deep-route separation and YACOE null).
E006-P1.scout_sentence: Same 40 time, higher tracked top speed: the receiver is faster at top end on Sundays.

E006-P2.sign_source: inferred from the E006 hypothesis text (the prereg has no expected_sign field)
E006-P2.label: Fitted 40 acceleration a0 → game max acceleration A0
caveats: Round 1 found the partial r in the wrong direction (pooled, -0.14); A0 at R = 20 draws.
The bound is for the pooled within-position partial r (WR/TE/DB/DL together); a position-specific effect (round-1 WR partial r +0.11 at n ~ 60) is not excluded by it.
WR a0 reliability 0.57 (0.40 within draft year).
E006-P2.scout_sentence: A faster-accelerating 40 (beyond the 10-yd split) means more explosive in-game acceleration.

E006-P3.sign_source: inferred from the E006 hypothesis text (the prereg has no expected_sign field)
E006-P3.label: Fitted 40 vmax → YAC over expected (WR + TE)
caveats: YACOE reliability ~0.55 (WR) and exposure-tied (r = +0.27 WR, +0.51 TE with log catches).
Outcome target: also run without the 2025 class.
2025 class has one season of games (rookie year only).
E006-P3.scout_sentence: Faster receivers gain more yards after the catch than expected.

E001-WR.sign_source: not preregistered: '+' from the E001 hypothesis (raw link); its beyond-B2 expectation was ~0, and the one-sided direction was set after the round-1 results were seen
E001-WR.label: 40 peak speed → game top speed (q95 of play max)
caveats: Seen before E006/E007 preregistrations (the lead that started the hidden-speed track).
Not preregistered: the one-sided '+' direction comes from the E001 hypothesis (raw link) and was set after round 1; its stated beyond-B2 expectation was ~0. Two-sided p reported alongside.
Feature is the max over attempts (device s; reliability computed for a max); target q95 of play max speed is exposure-invariant (split-half recomputed on the link sample).
E001-WR.scout_sentence: Same 40 time, higher tracked peak speed: a faster receiver in games.

E001-DB.sign_source: not preregistered: '+' from the E001 hypothesis (raw link); its beyond-B2 expectation was ~0, and the one-sided direction was set after the round-1 results were seen
E001-DB.label: 40 peak speed → game top speed (q95 of play max)
caveats: Game top speed reliability 0.63 for DB.
E001-DB.scout_sentence: Same 40 time, higher tracked peak speed: a faster DB in games.

E001-DL.sign_source: not preregistered: '+' from the E001 hypothesis (raw link); its beyond-B2 expectation was ~0, and the one-sided direction was set after the round-1 results were seen
E001-DL.label: 40 peak speed → game top speed (q95 of play max)
caveats: B2 (40 time, weight) explains most of DL top speed: little residual variance left.
E001-DL.scout_sentence: Same 40 time, higher tracked peak speed: a faster lineman in games.

E001-OL.sign_source: not preregistered: '+' from the E001 hypothesis (raw link); its beyond-B2 expectation was ~0, and the one-sided direction was set after the round-1 results were seen
E001-OL.label: 40 peak speed → game top speed (q95 of play max)
caveats: OL rarely reach top speed in games; target reliability 0.78.
E001-OL.scout_sentence: Same 40 time, higher tracked peak speed: a faster lineman in games.
